integrity: The determinant identity and crossover were reconstructed from the published equations and baseline values using exact rational arithmetic. No claim of independent validation is made.
scientific_limitations: The exact crossover is for the source's baseline parameter set and the one-parameter variation beta = R0 beta_c. The determinant proof does not claim nonlinear relaxation rates or dominance of -mu for all R0 above the crossover.
title: An exact near-threshold relaxation crossover in the SEITFR conjunctivitis model
